correctness.rationale: A_n mod 2 equals alpha^n+beta^n at the primitive p-th root xi by both recurrences. Trace xi=1 ensures alpha,beta are q-Frobenius conjugate with nonzero product; rho=alpha/beta lies in norm-one order Q group. Verified primality and complete factorizations of nine Q and 22 exact nonzero residues at Q/r force rho order Q. Integer Phi_p(±X) factors imply modulo-2 Phi_p factor, hence Q divides arbitrary n.

originality.rationale: The primary 2014 paper poses exactly this one-way implication as Conjecture 2 and offers only sufficient factor families. Complete finite-characteristic-two order certificates give a motivated nine-prime case over all positive indices; no exact or stronger dominating statement surfaced in the inspected literature or queried records, subject to explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: A later unlocated paper may prove the full Dilcher–Ericksen conjecture or the first nine cases via an equivalent Dickson-polynomial or norm-one-group formulation.
The later hyperbinary paper was inspected at abstract level, not in full; although no dominating claim appears in its abstract, this cannot by itself exclude coverage.
Semantic database searches cannot establish uniqueness or exhaustive historical priority.
